sourcesContent: import React, { useState } from 'react'; import { Box, Card, CardContent, Typography, Grid, Paper, Chip, IconButton, Divider, List, ListItem, ListItemIcon, ListItemText, LinearProgress, Accordion, AccordionSummary, AccordionDetails, Button, Dialog, DialogTitle, DialogContent, DialogActions, Tooltip, Avatar, } from '@mui/material'; import { ExpandMore as ExpandMoreIcon, ZoomIn as ZoomInIcon, Download as DownloadIcon, Print as PrintIcon, Share as ShareIcon, ArrowBack as BackIcon, CheckCircle as NormalIcon, Warning as WarningIcon, Error as AbnormalIcon, Rule as MeasurementIcon, Visibility as VisibilityIcon, Analytics as AnalyticsIcon, } from '@mui/icons-material'; import { DetailedViewData } from '../types'; interface DetailedResultsProps { data: DetailedViewData; onBack: () => void; onDownloadReport: () => void; onPrintReport: () => void; } const DetailedResults: React.FC = ({ data, onBack, onDownloadReport, onPrintReport, }) => { const [imageZoomOpen, setImageZoomOpen] = useState(false); const [expandedSections, setExpandedSections] = useState<{ [key: string]: boolean }>({ overview: true, vertebrae: false, spacing: false, abnormalities: false, technical: false, }); const handleSectionToggle = (section: string) => { setExpandedSections(prev => ({ ...prev, [section]: !prev[section] })); }; const getStatusColor = (status: 'normal' | 'abnormal') => { return status === 'normal' ? 'success' : 'error'; }; const getStatusIcon = (status: 'normal' | 'abnormal') => { return status === 'normal' ? : ; }; const getConfidenceColor = (confidence: number) => { if (confidence >= 0.8) return 'success'; if (confidence >= 0.6) return 'warning'; return 'error'; }; const renderSpacingAnalysis = (spacing: typeof data.spacingAnalysis) => ( L3-L4 Spacing {spacing.l3l4.value.toFixed(1)} mm Normal range: 4.0-8.0 mm L4-L5 Spacing {spacing.l4l5.value.toFixed(1)} mm Normal range: 4.0-8.0 mm L5-Sacrum Spacing {spacing.l5Sacrum.value.toFixed(1)} mm Normal range: 4.0-8.0 mm ); return ( {/* Header */} Detailed Analysis Report {data.imageName} • {new Date(data.analysisTime).toLocaleString()} {/* Left Column - Image and Basic Info */} {/* X-ray Image */} X-ray Image setImageZoomOpen(true)}> setImageZoomOpen(true)} > {/* Overall Status */} Overall Assessment {getStatusIcon(data.overallStatus)} Confidence: {Math.round(data.confidence * 100)}% {/* Right Column - Detailed Analysis */} {/* Vertebrae Analysis */} handleSectionToggle('vertebrae')} elevation={2} sx={{ mb: 2 }} > }> Vertebrae Analysis {Object.entries(data.vertebraeAnalysis).map(([vertebra, analysis]) => ( {vertebra.toUpperCase()} {getStatusIcon(analysis.status)} Integrity: {Math.round(analysis.integrity * 100)}% {analysis.findings.length > 0 && ( Findings: {analysis.findings.map((finding, index) => ( • {finding} ))} )} ))} {/* Spacing Analysis */} handleSectionToggle('spacing')} elevation={2} sx={{ mb: 2 }} > }> Spacing Measurements {renderSpacingAnalysis(data.spacingAnalysis)} {/* Abnormalities */} handleSectionToggle('abnormalities')} elevation={2} sx={{ mb: 2 }} > }> Abnormalities ({data.abnormalities.length}) {data.abnormalities.length > 0 ? ( {data.abnormalities.map((abnormality, index) => ( {index + 1} Location: {abnormality.location} Severity: {abnormality.severity} • Confidence: {Math.round(abnormality.confidence * 100)}% {abnormality.description} } /> ))} ) : ( No abnormalities detected All vertebrae appear normal )} {/* Technical Details */} handleSectionToggle('technical')} elevation={2} > }> Technical Details Analysis Method {data.technicalDetails.analysisMethod} Processing Time {data.technicalDetails.processingTime}ms Image Quality {data.technicalDetails.imageQuality} Algorithm Version {data.technicalDetails.algorithmVersion} {/* Zoom Dialog */} setImageZoomOpen(false)} maxWidth="lg" fullWidth > {data.imageName} setImageZoomOpen(false)}> ); }; export default DetailedResults;
